activity.notes: Roger-Bernard III, Count of Foix, concluded the first pariatge with the Bishop of Urgell on 8 September 1278, establishing joint sovereignty over Andorra. He remained the Foix co-ruler until his death on 3 March 1302.

sources.title: Història d'Andorra — Govern d’Andorra
sources.citation_text: The Government of Andorra states that the 1278 and 1288 pariatges between Bishop Pere d’Urtx and Count Roger Bernat III ended the struggle over Andorran sovereignty.

sources.title: The First Pariatge of Andorra — Library of Congress
sources.citation_text: The Library of Congress identifies the First Pariatge as signed on 8 September 1278 by Pere d’Urtx and Roger Bernat III and as settling their respective sovereign rights over Andorra.
